references.text: The first tribal leader, Nahshon from Judah, brought exactly the same offerings: a silver plate, a silver bowl, and fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering. This shows the standardized pattern for all the tribal leaders' gifts.
Nethanel from Issachar brought identical gifts, confirming that all the tribes contributed equally to the dedication of the tabernacle.
The description of plates and bowls made of pure gold for the tabernacle, showing the use of costly vessels in sanctuary service.
The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard unit of measurement, the same weight standard used here for the silver vessels.
The grain offering was to be made of fine flour mixed with oil, exactly as described in this verse.
Fine flour mixed with oil was used as part of the daily offerings, showing the established practice for grain offerings.
